recommendation: Keep the published fix. Treat any future move of detectedissue-expected-onset-type to terminology.hl7.org as follow-up for FHIR-55063 or another final terminology decision, not as part of this FHIR-50539 source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-50539 asked to add DetectedIssue.expectedOnsetType as an optional element. The Applied/Persuasive CDS resolution specified expectedOnsetType 0..1 CodeableConcept, a definition distinguishing rapid onset within 24 hours from delayed onset after 24 hours, and an extensible binding to a value set containing the available SNOMED CT delayed and sudden onset concepts with a note that a rapid-onset concept has been requested.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3841 and commit 61b717c66b48fbfff6cfdb706e24c08332c645e9 added the element and source/detectedissue/valueset-detectedissue-expected-onset-type.xml. The applied source had the correct element, cardinality, CodeableConcept type, definition, and SNOMED CT sudden/delayed concepts, but left the binding strength as example. Later QA/status cleanup commits filled binding metadata and removed the XML-only rapid-onset note, so the current rendered value set did not retain that approved note.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes detectedissue=DetectedIssue, assigns abbreviation dti, and marks DetectedIssue approved for CDS, making the edited files current build-scope source. CDS Confluence records show the rapid-onset SNOMED request discussion, a request to document the rapid value, and 2025-10-08 approval of the FHIR-50539 proposed resolution. A later Triaged issue, FHIR-55063, proposes THO migration for several DetectedIssue value sets including expected-onset-type, but it is not Applied/Published and does not govern this seed decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/detectedissue/structuredefinition-DetectedIssue.xml so DetectedIssue.expectedOnsetType uses an extensible binding with a non-example binding description. Updated source/detectedissue/valueset-detectedissue-expected-onset-type.xml so the value-set description visibly notes that a rapid-onset code has been requested and should be included once available. The local canonical was left unchanged because the THO move is a separate non-final issue and the THO site does not currently publish this value set.
source_changes: source/detectedissue/structuredefinition-DetectedIssue.xml: changed DetectedIssue.expectedOnsetType binding strength from example to extensible and updated the binding description.
source/detectedissue/valueset-detectedissue-expected-onset-type.xml: moved the requested rapid-onset code note into the rendered ValueSet description.
